extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor in Winchester asks about borrowing around £127,000 to pay inheritance tax on an estate worth about £708,500 that is mostly an illiquid property, with solicitors already instructed.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and passed to our probate funding team. To take it further we would need a copy of the will and confirmation of your appointment as executor, the estate accounts or an asset and liability schedule, a formal valuation of the Winchester property, details of any mortgage or charge over it, and the HMRC inheritance tax calculation together with the relevant payment deadline. It would also help to have written confirmation from Hollis Kowalski Partners that they are instructed and your authority for us to speak with them. Once we have those documents we will review the matter and come back to you. Nothing in this email should be taken as an offer of finance or as any indication of terms.
